title: UN briefs political parties on election assistance
detail: United Nations Bangladesh held a briefing for registered political parties on technical support to the Bangladesh Election Commission; the note reported that the BALLOT project had added almost 8 million new voters since its 2025 launch.

title: Election schedule announced for 12 February 2026
detail: The Chief Election Commissioner announced that the 13th parliamentary election and a national referendum would be held on 12 February 2026, with nomination, scrutiny, appeal, and campaign dates also outlined.

title: EU deploys Election Observation Mission
detail: The EU stated that, following an invitation from Bangladesh authorities, it deployed an Election Observation Mission for the parliamentary election scheduled for 12 February 2026.

title: Bangladesh votes in its first competitive parliamentary election since 2008
detail: Polling was held for the 13th National Parliament after the 2024 uprising and interim transition. The vote tested whether political competition, institutional management, and public participation could be restored on a nationwide scale.

title: BNP emerges as the leading parliamentary force
detail: Associated Press reported that local media and BNP leaders said the party had secured a parliamentary majority, making the election an immediate political turning point after the interim period.

title: EU observers call the process credible but note remaining risks
detail: The EU Election Observation Mission described the election as credible and competently managed, while also noting localized violence and continuing fear around manipulated online narratives.
